title: Human QAT packet — fast-forward format
author: Nei (quartermaster/continuity)
supersedes: JOSH-HUMAN-TEST-PACKET-M1-M4.md (t_2b654349, Rei) for the M4/M5.x legs
venue_direction: Aya (HYRAX DIRECTOR) 2026-08-17 — test venue is MIRAGE ISLE
scope: M4, M5.1, M5.2 (+ M5.3 when it lands)
how_it_works: Human testing must be CHEAP — no walking from start. Every milestone follows the same fast-forward shape:
spawn -> .kit hytest -> .teleport mirage -> run the numbered steps -> PASS/FAIL/CAVEAT

Every test has FIVE parts: (1) TESTING REQUIREMENTS — which REQ-M-* the test exercises; (2) PREREQUISITE SETUP — exact fast-forward commands; (3) TEST STEPS — numbered observable actions; (4) PASS/FAIL CRITERIA — deterministic check + feel ask; (5) VERDICT FORMAT — PASS / FAIL / CAVEAT + one-line why.
VERDICT RULE: H=PASS/FAIL can ONLY come from Josh running this packet. Nothing in this file claims a verdict; H stays UNKNOWN until the packet is run.

Runtime prerequisite: CT 133 prod stack (image aaemu-game:presence-demo @ 6d5a07cf49a5, pinned 95bb1c78e, deploy Mai t_442f3016, prod startup PASS 37 min) plus the hytest kit + mirage teleport from t_e1cf82c9 (Tai, in flight).

prerequisites.title: Prerequisite: t_e1cf82c9 (test-infra card, assignee Tai)

milestones.title: M4 — Trade / craft / transport
milestones.engineering_status: EXIT RECORD 2026-08-12 (t_97e59ffc, Rei t_abe87eaf ACCEPT), merged + DEPLOYED to CT 133, pinned 95bb1c78e. Bot coverage: M4ExitIntegratedSessionTests (4 scripted actors, real paths), per-object restart E2Es — function + persistence are PROVEN. What is NOT proven: the FEEL verdict. That is this section.

requirements.mechanic: Crafting: recipe prerequisites, material + labor consumption, output, workstation range
Trade packs: creation, backpack occupancy, placement/pickup, sale + reward
Vehicles: summon/despawn, passenger + cargo attachment, movement
Integrated exit: harvest → craft → pack → load → travel → sell → reward
M2 release validation — four players from clean reset (Josh solo approximation OK; two-player is the recorded baseline)
Restart assertions — bot-covered (M4_2TradePackRestart / M4Vehicles); Josh spot-checks one restart sighting only
A2 broadcast economics — bot-covered (verified at M4 entry); not a Josh ask

setup: 1. Login (any character; GM level required for commands — AccessLevel >= 100).
2. .kit hytest          -> level 50 equiv, labor, gold, portals, gear.
FALLBACK (until t_e1cf82c9 lands): use a Mirage Isle Portal doodad in the main world (e.g. Solis 1.2 Mirage Portal) OR .teleport solzreed -> (15369, 13864, 159) and use the island portal there.
4. Confirm the craft station cluster renders at (3481-3493, 4302-4336) and the farm plot at (3585-3597, 4373-4384).
milestones.fixed_point: Fixed point for M4 feel: pack 26489 (golden potato bundle) via craft 5404 (3 x golden potato 19887), sell at Solzreed bundle 10. Canonical math: base = floor(14500 x 4913/1000) + 20000 = 91238; payout = round(91238 x 130% x 1.05) = 124540; labor -60; pack consumed.

tests.step: Harvest: at farm plot (3585-3597, 4373-4384), work the potato doodad (2259) to harvest potatoes (7992) + golden potatoes (19887)
tests.pass: Items appear in inventory; crop phases advance visually; harvest replants/resets cleanly
tests.feel: Does the growth/harvest animation read correctly? Does the crop look alive while growing?

tests.step: Craft: at the craft station cluster, craft golden potato pack 26489 (craft 5404) using 3 x 19887 + labor
tests.pass: Pack appears in Backpack slot; labor deducted -60 per pack; materials consumed
tests.feel: Does the craft animation/UI feel right? Is the pack visibly a carried pack on your back?

tests.step: Load: summon a vehicle (test-drive Comet Speedster 18260 at the vehicle pad) and place the pack on the slave cargo point
tests.pass: Pack attaches at the cargo point (snap-to-cargo behavior); binding row exists; pack stays on vehicle during motion
tests.feel: Does the pack load visually onto the vehicle? Does it look attached, not floating?

tests.step: Drive: board and drive the vehicle a short route (e.g. pad -> vendor plaza ~100m)
tests.pass: Vehicle moves smoothly; character rides; pack stays attached; dismount leaves pack on vehicle
tests.feel: Does driving feel responsive? Does the world react (collision, terrain)?

tests.step: Sell: .teleport solzreed -> walk to gold trader Misty (10664) at (15180.1, 13612.4, 103.9), sell the pack
tests.pass: Sell accepted; mail rewards arrive: 124540 gold; labor -60; pack consumed; not sellable same-zone (StoreCantSellSameZone if tried in origin zone)
tests.feel: Does the sale feel satisfying? Does the payout mail arrive visibly? Do you get the classic ArcheAge trade run feeling?

tests.step: Restart spot-check (optional, REQ-M4-6 sighting): after any natural server restart during play, re-enter and confirm vehicle/pack state intact
tests.pass: Vehicle + cargo present exactly once (no dup, no loss)

milestones.title: M5.1 — Economic extension (contract actions)
milestones.engineering_status: All 9 actions merged, Rei-gated, real engine paths (Plant/Harvest/Craft/PackPickup/PutDown/BoardVehicle/Buy/Sell/Deposit/Withdraw + LoadPackOntoVehicle + DriveVehicle). Bot coverage: per-action tests 240/240 family + Phase-2 replay (t_b4f455b0). What is NOT proven: how the ACTIONS LOOK when a human does them. That is this section.

requirements.mechanic: Economic action surface: Plant, Harvest, Craft, PackPickup/PutDown, BoardVehicle, Buy/Sell, Deposit/Withdraw
Every action executes through its REAL engine path — Josh sees real engine behavior, no shortcuts
LoadPackOntoVehicle — pack snaps to slave cargo point via real path
DriveVehicle — client-authored movement while boarded
Exit: curated farm/craft/pack/vehicle/trade segment (Housing.Build FIRST, then farm/storage → craft → pack → load/drive → unload → sell → reward)

setup: Same as M4: .kit hytest then .teleport mirage (fallbacks in M4 setup).
Land at (3680.5, 4572.2, 156). Facility map (venue prereq) applies.

tests.step: Plant: use a seed from the hytest kit on the farm plot (3585-3597, 4373-4384)
tests.pass: Seed consumes; crop doodad spawns at position; cycle state advances
tests.feel: Does the planting gesture/animation read right? Does the seed visibly go into the ground?

tests.step: Harvest: work the grown crop
tests.pass: Items land in bag; crop phases advance; harvest completes
tests.feel: Does the crop look ready/grown before harvest? Does harvest feel like the farm is alive?

tests.step: Craft: craft an item at the Fellowship Workbench (7701) or Regal cluster
tests.pass: Craft completes via real CharacterCraft path; labor deducted; item lands in bag
tests.feel: Does the craft station read as a proper station? Does the item appear plausibly in the bag?

tests.step: PackPickup/PutDown: create a pack (26489 chain or kit-provided), pick it up, put it down near a vehicle
tests.pass: Pack occupies backpack slot on pickup; placed pack appears as a world object on putdown
tests.feel: Does the pack visually ride on the character when carried? Does it sit correctly on the ground when placed?

tests.step: LoadPackOntoVehicle: put the placed pack onto the test-drive vehicle cargo point
tests.pass: Pack snaps to cargo point (real snap-to-cargo behavior); binding recorded
tests.feel: Does the pack snap cleanly, or clip/float? Does it track the vehicle when it moves?

tests.step: BoardVehicle + Drive: board the vehicle, drive a route, dismount
tests.pass: Real BindSlave/Seat.LoadPassenger + VehicleMovementModel path; movement broadcasts observed
tests.feel: Does boarding feel right? Does driving feel like driving, not teleporting?

tests.step: Buy/Sell + Deposit/Withdraw: buy from General Vendor (7961), sell something back, deposit/withdraw at Auctioneer/Warehouse (7983)
tests.pass: Buy deducts gold and grants item; sell grants gold; warehouse deposit/withdraw round-trips currency/items
tests.feel: Do shop + storage UIs feel like the classic mall? Do items/currency move visibly?

tests.step: Exit segment (REQ-M5.1-5): chain E1→E7 in order (Build FIRST for E3 craft if housing-gated, else farm first)
tests.pass: Whole loop completes with no engine refusal; conservation holds (labor, currency, mail 124540/pack)
tests.feel: Does the FULL economic loop feel like a coherent game loop end-to-end?

verdict_format: M5.1-E1..E8: PASS / FAIL / CAVEAT — <one line why each>
OVERALL M5.1 FEEL: PASS / FAIL / CAVEAT — <the economy-feels-alive verdict>

requirements.mechanic: BuildHouse contract action over the REAL HousingManager.Build engine path

setup: Use the housing design cluster @ (3528-3538, 4370-4380) or the farmhouse design @ (3854, 4611) / aquafarm @ (3659, 4423) as the placement surface. Kit provides the house design (level/gold/labor already covered by hytest).

tests.step: Place: use the house design from the kit at a valid spot in the housing cluster
tests.pass: Placement accepted at a valid spot; construction state begins; house object appears
tests.feel: Does the placement ghost/validation read correctly? Does the construction start look right?

tests.step: Construct: run the build to completion (watches or instant per kit/command)
tests.pass: Construction completes; door/window phases exist; house usable (door opens)
tests.feel: Does the house LOOK like a house a player would want? Scale/lighting/entrance feel?

tests.pass: House persists and is interactable before planting/crafting in that session
tests.feel: Does build-first ordering feel natural for the Phase-2 route?

requirements.mechanic: Observe — one unified observation snapshot through real engine queries
Move — real 1.2 client-authored movement path (no silent transform teleport)
Stop — real 1.2 halt semantics, interrupt of running request
Target — real engine target-set path (Unit.CurrentTarget)
Cast — one skill through the real character skill pipeline (Character.UseSkill)
Threading-boundary, idempotency, audit trail, contract tests, exit — bot/rig evidence; Josh asks are the five ACTION feels only

setup: Same fast-forward (.kit hytest -> .teleport mirage). Actions are driven from the control-plane/MCP surface (t_446228b5) or GM surface — the human's part is watching the client react and judging whether the WORLD responds correctly.
Mirage targets: use the island's NPCs (Mirage Isle Guide 10916-10925) as move/target practice targets; open ground near the vehicle pad for movement.

tests.step: Observe: while standing on the island, run one Observe call
tests.pass: Snapshot equals what the client shows: your position, nearby units, state
tests.feel: Does the snapshot match what you SEE on screen?

tests.step: Move: issue Move to a nearby point (e.g. vehicle pad -> vendor plaza)
tests.pass: Character walks via the real movement path; movement broadcasts reach the client; arrival completes
tests.feel: Does the character walk smoothly with a real animation, no snapping?

tests.step: Stop: issue Move, then Stop mid-walk
tests.pass: Movement halts cleanly; request ends Interrupted("stop requested")
tests.feel: Does the character stop naturally (decelerate), not freeze mid-pose?

tests.step: Target: target a Mirage guide NPC
tests.pass: Target resolves (CurrentTarget set); selection indicator appears
tests.feel: Does targeting feel like classic AA targeting?

tests.step: Cast: cast one learned skill (kit must grant one) at the NPC
tests.pass: Skill executes through real pipeline; mana/cooldown consumed; effect applies
tests.feel: Does the cast animation/time play correctly? Does the world react (damage/buff)?

verdict_format: M5.3-C1..C5: PASS / FAIL / CAVEAT — <one line why each>
OVERALL M5.3 FEEL: PASS / FAIL / CAVEAT — <the actions-feel-native verdict>
